Method of Attack: Ransomware locking Android devices by demanding ransom payment
Uses QQ instant messaging username for contact and negotiation
Unlocks device by having user speak a four-string unlock code using Baidu TTS API
Stores unlock code in device filesystem under /Assets files
Indicators of Compromise: QQ instant messaging username displayed on ransom screen
2D barcode (previous variant) linking to ransom payment URL
Unlock code stored in /Assets files on device filesystem
Ransom notes written only in Chinese
Use of Baidu TTS API for speech recognition
